facts.fact: Bowmans reports that the National Treasury and Central Bank of Kenya published the National Payment System Bill, 2026 for public consultation, with comments due 9 October 2026, to repeal the current National Payment System Act, Cap. 491A.

Bowmans describes the National Payment System Act, Cap. 491A as the current Act, which commenced in 2014 and which the 2026 Bill would repeal; it also refers to current regulations under it on suspension and revocation of licences.
